description_en: Generates the token required for interactive messaging
description_zh: 生成直播互动消息所需的token
kebab_example: aliyun ice generate-message-chat-token --ai-agent-id 19de81b3b3d94abda22000000 --user-id YOURUSERID --role user --expire 3600 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateMessageChatToken

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI agent
parameters.name: ai_agent_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user to sign in. It can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, and underscores (\_)
parameters.help_zh: 要登录的用户的 ID。 仅限 A-Z,a-z,0-9 及"_"，最长 64 字节
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The role. A value of admin indicates that the user can perform management operations. This parameter is empty by default
parameters.help_zh: 角色，为 admin 时，表示该用户可以调用“管控类”接口。默认空
parameters.name: role

parameters.help_en: The validity period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 3600
parameters.help_zh: 超时时间，单位秒，默认 3600 秒
parameters.name: expire
